acceptanceCriteria: The header Delivery status and the digest Status in corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md agree.
Either specindex refuses a header Delivery status that disagrees with the digest Status (one maintained test, one mutation), or a recorded decision explains why the prefix rule is intended.
body: Residual from the V1-1313/1320/1321 tasks claim/renew lane (PR #915, branch claude/tasks-claim-renew-1321-1313-1320, head e6f5e9208, base 595359a1b). docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md line 6 'Delivery status:' does not list the CAL-V0-225..229 (and now 230/231) segment that the Agent digest '- Status:' line (~42) carries. The specindex check accepts the header as a prefix, so the drift is not caught. Expected: both status lines agree, or one is derived/checked against the other.
title: corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0: header 'Delivery status:' lags the Agent digest '- Status:' by the CAL-V0-225..229 segment; specindex accepts the prefix
